title: PVL: Humbled by two losses, High Speed Hitters connect by embracing imperfections, pressure
summary: PLDT libero-captain Kath Arado admitted that they were humbled by their first two losses to kick off their campaign in the 2026 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference Siklab series.
